acip: DE DAG GIS BDAG GI MING THOS NAS 'DZIN PA DANG, MCHOD PAS LAS KYI SGRIB PA DE YONGS SU BYANG STE, TSE RING BAR GYUR CIG ,NAD MED PAR GYUR CIG ,SU YANG DUS MA YIN PAR 'CHI BAS 'CHI BA'I DUS BYED PAR MA GYUR CIG CES BTAB BO,,
wylie: de dag gis bdag gi ming thos nas 'dzin pa dang, mchod pas las kyi sgrib pa de yongs su byang ste, tshe ring bar gyur cig ,nad med par gyur cig ,su yang dus ma yin par 'chi bas 'chi ba'i dus byed par ma gyur cig ces btab bo
english: And when these people hear my name, and keep it; and when they make their offerings; then may all of their karmic obstacles be cleaned from them, completely.  May they come to live long lives; may they never fall ill.  May it never happen, to anyone in the universe at all, that they come to an untimely death. Finest Gold's second prayer, to stop poverty
